data.title: 木地板上压低的嘘声提醒
data.location: 铺着橙色靠垫的安静公寓木地板
data.lighting: 室内自然窗光均匀柔照
data.camera: 正上方俯视面部特写横幅
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, shiki_natsume, side braid with white rose hair ornament and purple ribbon, crisp white shirt, lying on polished wooden floor beside orange cushion, index finger pressed lightly to lips in hush pose, other hand resting near ear, shy blush, golden eyes gazing straight up at viewer, bright natural indoor window light, from directly above, face close-up
data.animaCaption: Lying on the warm wooden floor beside an orange floor cushion with a white rose woven into her side braid, she presses one slender finger gently against her lips and looks straight up at you with a shy blush. Clean indoor daylight brightens her crisp white shirt and golden eyes.
data.promptProse: Framed directly from overhead in a tight horizontal close-up, Shiki Natsume lies on a sunlit hardwood floor beside a vivid orange cushion, her black hair styled in a delicate side braid adorned with a white rose and purple ribbon. Wearing a crisp white shirt, she lifts one index finger lightly to her lips in a hushed warning while her other hand rests near her ear, meeting the viewer's eyes with a quiet rosy flush under clean natural daylight.
data.story: 午后安静的房间里，侧编着白玫瑰发饰的夏目仰躺在微凉木地板上，竖起一根手指轻轻抵在唇边仰望你，眼底带着藏不住的窘迫与叮嘱——「嘘……声音太大了，会被隔壁听见的。」
